lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is a special board meeting at Telluride Regional Medical Center on Thursday, where the board goes into executive session and then takes a public vote on interim hospital leadership — that's consequential for everyone in this valley. Alongside that, Mountain Village takes up a first reading of an ordinance that would move Housing Authority fees out of municipal code and into an annually adjustable fee schedule, HARC holds a work session on a potential demolition and new construction at Rebekah Hall — the town-owned building where they actually meet — and the BOCC continues its discussion of constitutional amendments and a long-standing view-plain MOU.

notable.stake: Work session on potential demolition of Town-owned Rebekah Hall; Phoenix Market review.
